resources.string: Some phones (OnePlus, Xiaomi, Samsung and others) stop background apps to save battery, and the floating mic disappears until you turn it on again. In Battery settings, show all apps, pick Hebrish and choose Don\'t optimise. On OnePlus, also check App info → Battery → Unrestricted.
Other apps (Tasker, a launcher, a remote\'s companion app) can start and stop takes with the broadcast intents below. Binding hardware keys directly is in the F-Droid and APK builds only.
It does not see your key presses.
